claims.text: The approach improves model training transparency by soliciting informative keywords from the crowd, providing human-understandable explanations for the model's performance improvements.
By leveraging the disagreement between the model and the crowd, the approach identifies new informative keywords that enhance model performance and understanding of the learning process.
The method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models, demonstrating its effectiveness in improving both accuracy and interpretability in event detection tasks.
